Aarti Industries enters into a 10+ year strategic and dedicated manufacturing &
supply agreement with a global speciality chemical company
The dedicated long-term arrangement offers an estimated revenue potential of ₹1,500
crores over the contract period.
Mumbai, October 13, 2026: Aarti Industries Limited (AIL), a leading global manufacturer of
speciality chemicals, today announced that it has entered into a 10+ year dedicated
manufacturing and supply agreement with a leading global speciality chemical company serving
diverse industries with a cumulative revenue potential of approximately Rs 1500 crores (about
US$150 million) over its contract term. The agreement establishes a new customer relationship
for AIL and supports the customer’s expanding requirements in India.
AIL will set up, commission, and operate a dedicated manufacturing facility in India for a speciality
chemical used in high-performance applications, based on the customer's proprietary process
technology and a structured financial arrangement to finance CAPEX of less than US$25 million.
The model combines global technology with AIL’s process scale-up, engineering, and operating
capabilities to provide a critical manufacturing outsourcing solution to global companies.

Dear Sir/Madam,
This is to inform you that the Company received yesterday, i.e., October 12, 2026, the order bearing reference
no. WTM/KCV/CFD/11/2025-26 dated October 9, 2026, passed by the Securities and Exchange Board of
India (“SEBI”), in the matter of the proposed acquisition of shares and voting rights in NGL Fine-Chem
Limited (Target Company) by Ajita Nachane Family Trust and Rahul Nachane Family Trust.
Vide the said order, SEBI has granted exemption to Ajita Nachane Family Trust and Rahul Nachane
Family Trust, the proposed acquirers, from complying with the requirements of Regulations 3(1) and 4 of
the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, in respect of the proposed
acquisition of shares of the Company, as under:
Target Company
NGL Fine-Chem Limited

Proposed Acquirers
1. Ajita Nachane Family Trust
2. Rahul Nachane Family Trust

The proposed acquisition involves the transfer of 7,13,449 equity shares (11.55%) held by
Mrs. Ajita Nachane (Transferor) and 10,83,450 equity shares (17.54%) held by Mr. Rahul Nachane
(Transferor), aggregating to 17,96,899 equity shares, representing 29.09% of the total paid-up equity share
capital of the Company, to the respective family trusts.
There will be no change in the total shareholding of the Promoter and Promoter Group in the Target Company
before and after the aforesaid transaction.
A copy of the said Order is enclosed for your reference.
You are requested to take the above information on record.
Thanking you,
Yours faithfully,
